plan.title: RFQ Vendor Bid Above Price Cap

steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow for the RFQ.
Enable price-cap validation required by the case.
Make the event an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding items.
Add the single line on which the cap applies.
Invite the named vendor to the RFQ.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ's participant list to configure the vendor cap.
Set the buyer's price cap to 100 for Vendor A before bidding.
Verify the saved cap is exactly 100.
Move to the separate Vendor A portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this live RFQ from Vendor A's event list at the pricing sheet.

args.because: Price cannot be more than the allowed price

steps.note: Submit a quote above the cap and require Procol's price-cap refusal.
Confirm the quote at 100 was accepted by the vendor portal.
